messages.subject: For Pietro Salini | Global infrastructure, government partnerships and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Webuild Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Pietro Salini, Chief Executive Officer.

Webuild's global infrastructure portfolio depends on disciplined collaboration among governments, clients, communities and project teams. That operating interface closely matches my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and infrastructure stakeholder execution might support Webuild's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Webuild.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
